verdict.rationale: Recurly runs recurring, time-driven workflows inside its billing domain: usage charges at the end of every billing cycle, dunning campaigns that control when retries and emails happen, and subscription changes with configurable timing. The evidence shows no general-purpose way for users to define and schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined scheduled jobs/workflows, cron-style or programmable scheduling via API/MCP, and documentation of a scheduling/automation builder.
